name: m0x6a
description: Field-tested Claude Code skills and agents: Grafana operations, a gated feature workflow, attention-first code review, web UX audits and .NET messaging.

plugins.name: grafana-ops
plugins.description: Investigate production incidents from live Grafana data (metrics, logs, traces) with a trust-check-first procedure, and keep alerts and dashboards as code with a linter, publisher and live verifier.

plugins.name: feature-workflow
plugins.description: Issue → spec → approval before code, at the right size: a router picks trivial, small (one spec-and-tasks document, one gate) or full (reviewed system design, then reviewed implementation plan). Mermaid diagrams, caveats checklist, risk map and pattern catalogue on the full track.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Pull-request review that tells a maintainer with ten minutes where to look first, plus a repeatable architecture audit, a boundary guardian and a docs reconciler.

plugins.name: web-ux
plugins.description: Design-system UI building, UX review, WCAG 2.2 AA audits and end-to-end journey checks in a real browser, judged against an explicit craft bar.

plugins.name: dotnet-messaging
plugins.description: MassTransit consumers (outbox tiers, idempotency, respond-or-publish), thin BFF gateway endpoints over request clients, and safe EF Core migrations.

plugins.name: voice-issue
plugins.description: Speak a note; it is transcribed locally and drafted into a structured GitHub issue you review before it is created.

plugins.name: issue-picker
plugins.description: List the open issues of the current repository, pick one, and start Claude on it here or in a new tmux window.
